title: The fan room
lede: Pin your favorite panel, take the quiz, and leave your interpretation. Everything stays on your own device.
storageNote: Community features are currently stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and never sent to any server. The architecture uses an adapter layer so it can be connected to a backend later.

wall.title: Favorite panel wall
wall.intro: Describe your favorite panel or moment in your own words. Text only, no images, and no copying manga dialogue.
wall.textPlaceholder: E.g. when Yugeru complains about his clothes for the umpteenth time…

board.title: Interpretation board
board.intro: What does 資格 mean to you? Is the ending happy? Write your interpretation and back others you agree with.

seeds.author: Site team
seeds.text: The moment his body is whole again and the first thing he checks is his sleeve. The story's entire sense of humor lives there.

seeds.author: Site team
seeds.text: The empty room after Shikaku leaves. No explosions, no dialogue, and somehow it is the loudest moment.

seeds.author: Site team
seeds.text: The title is in katakana so we can't know which kanji is meant until the end. Shikaku turns from 刺客 into 資格 exactly when she stops killing.

seeds.author: Site team
seeds.text: Yugeru never truly wanted to die. He wanted someone to care whether he lived or died.

quiz.title: Are you Shikaku or Yugeru?
quiz.intro: Seven questions, no wrong answers. Your result can be downloaded as a card and shared.

questions.q: There is an impossible task. You…

a.t: Try again tomorrow. And the day after. And the day after that.
Observe first; there may be a more elegant way.
Try once, very dramatically, and see what happens.
Fine clothes I've worn for centuries.
My work tools. Always clean, always ready.
Memories, not things.
Go looking for trouble. Literally.
Reread a book I've read a hundred times.
Wait for something unexpected to knock.
Keep showing up, no matter what.
Set out two cups of tea without being asked.
Offer something very personal.

questions.q: If you fail in front of a crowd, you…

a.t: Cry as loudly as possible. Let everyone know.
Stay calm, then complain about a small detail.
Laugh, because what else can you do.
刺客 — assassin
不死 — undying
資格 — qualification

questions.q: The next three thousand years sound like…

a.t: Enough time to finally succeed.
Exhausting. Unless someone keeps me company.
An adventure.

shikaku.name: Shikaku
shikaku.tagline: Relentless, impulsive, sincere to the point of danger.
shikaku.body: You don't stop until it's done, and you love with everything you have, sometimes too much. Remember: failing does not revoke your right to be loved.

yugeru.name: Yugeru
yugeru.body: You've seen a lot and are rarely surprised. But when someone truly pays attention to you, your boredom thaws faster than you expect.

both.name: Shikaku × Yugeru
both.body: You have Shikaku's persistence and Yugeru's patience. You may be the best person to mediate their contract.
